from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0047.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let scan columns 160 to 340 to find the bottom of the cabinet (not floor):
# Floor is roughly [150..160, 140..155, 125..140]
# Cabinet front face is pure white [255, 255, 255], side face is darker grey/brown [132, 126, 113] or [186, 160, 127]
for u in range(160, 340, 10):
    for v in range(300, 450):
        c = img[v, u]
        # check if it is floor
        is_floor = (c[0] < 165) and (c[1] < 155) and (c[2] < 145) and (c[0] > 140) and (c[1] > 130) and (c[2] > 120)
        # check if cabinet
        is_cab = (c[0] > 200 and c[1] > 200 and c[2] > 200) or (c[0] > 170 and c[1] > 140 and c[2] > 110)
    # lets find max v that is cabinet:
    cab_vs = []
    for v in range(300, 450):
        c = img[v, u]
        if (c[0] > 200 and c[1] > 200 and c[2] > 200) or (c[0] < 140 and c[1] < 135 and c[2] < 125):
            cab_vs.append(v)
    if len(cab_vs) > 0:
        print(f"u={u}: max_v={max(cab_vs)}")
'
